Q5786.reason: Under the eggshell-plaintiff rule, refusal of treatment on religious grounds is foreseeable and not a superseding cause, so full wrongful death damages are recoverable (D, contributory negligence, is the weaker alternative).

Q5086.reason: Anaerobic metabolism is ATP generation in the absence of available oxygen, as opposed to merely not using it.

Q5171.reason: Transfusion should start within about 30 minutes of removal from refrigeration, but the commonly cited window before deterioration is 90 minutes, and B fits the allowed choices.
